arrive.text: A sunny afternoon. The sun is warm on your face, and everything feels real.

wonder.text: Have you ever wondered how any of this came to exist? What reality actually is, underneath everything you can touch.

solid.text: The grass, the trees, the warmth. All of it feels solid.

edge.text: The world ends here. By some incredible glitch, or magic, you've glimpsed the true nature of reality.

ask.text: Something flickers at the edge of your vision. Will you go after it, and try to see what's beneath?

fall.text: You step off, and go looking for what's beneath.

lab_1.text: A brain, in a jar of fluid. Wires. A humming machine. And above it, the world you just left.

lab_2.text: So this is what's real. Isn't it?

layer_2.text: Another brain. Another machine. Another world above it.

sit.text: You sit down. The sun is warm.

stay_end.text: Real or not, it's the only sun you have.

end.text: However far you step out, you're still looking through the same eyes.

tree.text: A perfect tree. Every leaf exactly where you'd expect it.

window.text: Nobody home. Come to think of it, you've never seen anyone go in.

machine.text: Reels turning, lights blinking. Somewhere in here is that tree.

machine_2.text: Up there, you called it a tree. Did you mean a real tree, or this machine's picture of one? The picture is all you've ever touched.

sit_rest.text: You sit. The sun is warm, the grass smells of summer. You could sit here all afternoon, just feeling it.

machine_3.text: Another machine. It's labelled in words you know. Your words.

stool_end.text: You sit down by the machine. You've decided this one is real.
